subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises 3-letter consonant blends at the beginning of words (str-ip, str-ap)

show.line: Three sounds stuck together! s-t-r. Strip, strap, string, street. Say them fast!

rounds.prompt: Listen. s-t-r. Which picture starts with s-t-r?
Listen. s-t-r-a-p. Put the sounds together. What word is it?
Listen. s-p-r. Which picture starts with s-p-r?
Listen. s-c-r-u-b. What word is it?
Starts with s-t-r, or starts with s-p-r? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Say the three sounds slowly, then faster, until they join.
Listen to the very start of the word. Three sounds before the vowel.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will put these sounds together. s-t-r-i-p.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I dropped the first sound. s-t-r-i-p says strip.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say the sounds together. s-t-r-i-p. Strip!

parent_line: Can blend three consonant sounds at the start of a word, like str and spr.
